question: Can the public entry distinguish actual recipient artifacts, SDK-required experiments and laboratory evidence while a continuous walkthrough records one unchanged recipient execution?
unit_boundary: ONE artifact-aware portfolio contribution. Navigation, provenance checks, walkthrough capture and supporting verification are not extra product, laboratory, participant or package units.

baseline.preserve: No runtime, owners, gameplay rules, journal format, package, media, notices or protected source changes. Existing Windows recipient remains a separate preserved artifact.

rival_explanations: A polished page may falsely imply that newer source experiments are included in older recipient downloads.
A stitched or state-injected demonstration may display outcomes that no continuous actual execution reached.
Successful automated navigation or capture may be mistaken for human comprehension, enjoyment, author approval or platform production readiness.
navigation_acceptance: Public entry differentiates private-runtime recipient downloads from source experiments requiring SDK/runtime tools.
Advertised package bytes and SHA256 match actual retained ZIPs.
Source-only field journey and passive study are not advertised as packaged recipient content.
Laboratory maturity remains tied to the existing authoritative catalog; Build/Operations stays incomplete.
Selected demonstrations link actual sources, instructions, evidence and explicit execution boundaries.
Meaningful negative checks reject false content inclusion, stale artifact identity and unsupported Unity or production readiness.
walkthrough_acceptance: Extract the exact retained Linux recipient into a new external scratch location and launch its unchanged private runtime without rebuilding the payload.
Record one continuous visible browser execution from initial local scene through actual accepted choices and actual nested encounter outcomes, without runtime state injection or replacement owners.
Disclose capture environment, browser/runtime versions, viewport, explicit automation, command/input sequence and whether a preexisting save was used.
Keep original continuous capture and machine-readable command/results evidence; derived compact views or frames must identify their relation to the original.
Final visible outcome must correspond to the same actual scene/journal observation, preserving costs, consent, observed return and unfinished work.
Preserve failures, capture refusals or superseded output explicitly; do not silently recast a later corrected capture as the first execution.
Stop owned processes and bind source/package identities before and after execution.
limits: This is an automated Linux recipient walkthrough, not a player, author or device study.
Automation may know action policy and observe developer/API state; disclose actual access rather than claiming blind play.
Continuous capture demonstrates the recorded sequence, not every possible action, platform, persistence or failure path.
No Unity Editor, activation/modules, Windows ordinary-user, Steam, power-loss, distributed persistence, accessibility, musical quality, balance or commercial clearance follows.
Integrity and negative controls bind specific claims and artifacts; they do not prove future prose, artistic quality or human comprehension.

brain_influence.SCI-013: Prespecify rival artifact and capture explanations.
brain_influence.SCI-014: Separate artifact truth and observed execution from human constructs.
brain_influence.SCI-076: Select checks for correspondence and capture provenance, reserving comprehension for actual participants.
brain_influence.SCI-077: Avoid duplicated evidence, simulated population claims and polished presentation as substitute validation.
